# Service improvement plan

The service improvement plan sets the order of work for the next year. It starts from what passengers asked for in the latest survey, listed here with the share of people who chose each item.

- Shorter waits at peak hours: 58%
- Real-time bus arrival information: 35%
- Cleaner buses and better ventilation: 22%
- Electric and quieter buses: 19%

Each item gets an owner and a date in the next planning round. Work on the first item starts in spring.
